reviews.text: [h1] 直接说结论：不推荐任何人游玩或购买！ [/h1] 有时间干点啥不好？有钱买点啥不行？ 哪怕去艹拉万，把眼睛闭上起码你也能享受到欢乐和快感（相较于这款游戏），而玩这款游戏，睁眼闭眼都是在赤石。 严重怀疑开发团队的精神状态和能力。 游戏开发团队试图用所谓的“机制”来掩盖开发能力的不足以及想象力的贫瘠。 自己没点B活就限制玩家能力，让玩家没苦硬吃； 自己没点本事就搞一些自己认为能糊弄玩家的陷阱然后教玩家玩游戏； 自己没点数值管理能力就瞎几把闲置品炮塔的数量； 自己知道自己的游戏数值崩坏就瞎几把躺平； 自己知道游戏体量不行就刻意拉长玩家成长所需时间； 自己没点新东西新点子就出个可有可无的roadmap。 至于玩家就更加可怜了。 只能通过补给信标开新东西； 补给信标会开出已解锁的东西； 补给信标大概率开出船员+物资+研究点三选一的司马组合（马就是开发团队所有人的马。司的就是他们的马）； 玩家会遇到敌方导弹，敌方导弹倒计时通过消耗敌方回合计算，命中之后直接GG； 开发团队通过敌方导弹限制玩家探索规模，从而减少玩家单周目的成长，增加玩家各种成本； 多艘敌舰遭遇就算多个敌方回合； 多艘敌舰+追击舰+导弹的终极牛逼负反馈； 开出一堆废物也不给玩家一个能用的炮塔； 通过星门之后奖励是司马三选一：上传蓝图/多一个武器格子/多一个部署物格子； 但是就是不给能用的炮塔。玩那么多周目，包括更新后的困难周目，通关到现在只给我一个霰弹炮塔； 为什么不给玩家炮塔，因为制作团队不会做游戏，没任何有趣的内容可以给玩家。制作团队没活了，啥也整不出。 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 电击塔有什么用？ 优点： 及其优秀的弱引导。在不标注地图和进攻路线的情况下，玩家可以轻易做到确定敌方进攻防线和优先防守区域，也能做到不迷路。能看出开发团队在地图设计上下了一番功夫。这里也能看出开发团队在美工上关于视觉引导方面的功底。 行动部分节奏紧凑，毫无垃圾时间，打起来轻松愉快。 ----------------以下为原测评----------------- [h1] 绍伊古！格拉西莫夫！我炮塔呢？！ [/h1] 最近更新：多周目过了，刷残骸就是不出炮塔。哪怕出两个物资箱一个武器箱，或者两个武器箱一个研究点，也不出带炮塔的部署物箱子。现在已经消气了，甚至有点想笑。。。。。 ----------------------------以下为原测评（纯发泄）----------------------------- 明明给我一个机枪塔就能解决很多问题，非要硬塞给我一大堆花里胡哨的没尼玛逼用的陷阱。开发人员你们觉得这样很有趣是不是？要不要以后你们每次艹逼之前先猜二十个灯谜然后再玩几把华容道接着再来个数独全对才让艹？学人家兽人必须死，又没那个创意也没那个本事，还非要把炮塔憋着不让玩家得到。呆逼想出来的呆逼设计。 开发人员是不是在那自我感动，自认为设计出了很多有趣的陷阱对吧？冲击板？垂直悬浮器？涡流方格？瞧瞧你们都干了些啥！好好看看！ 你初始炮塔都不给，都给些什么B玩意？！ 尼玛打完一周目，残骸全选部署物，都没出炮塔。给的什么B玩意？出尼玛传送带出尼玛弹药制造机出尼玛刀片墙就尼玛烂逼不出炮塔艹。 马个烂逼打完第二周目刷残骸就尼玛逼不出炮塔我炮尼玛烂逼塔就是不出。最后我干尼玛机车，刷残骸直接不出部署物选项。就出尼玛物资武器道具。我要炮塔，要的是炮尼玛烂逼的塔我日尼玛臭嗨个逼 尼玛要不是outpost晚一天发售我能玩这逼玩意？尼木琴的柰子都刷出来了就是刷不出炮尼玛逼塔的傻缺玩意

I was waiting for this games launch and I want to leave a neutral review. I love tower defense and this reminded me of Orcs Must Die from ages ago, the gameplay has the same intensity and on the second map section the games difficulty started to spike to enjoyable levels... until it ended. I know its EA, I know its a small team, but finishing the game in under 2 hours and then just replaying it like a roguelike would only be fine for me if it was at least 5 map sectors or so like FTL did. The game just was getting really fun and ends... We need to see if the dev continues on this game. If it gets more updates at a good pace I will rebuy it and recommend it, but for the price its asking for the length until the first clear, its too short and not worth it.

之前发现这游戏的时候只知道是FPS合作塔防，上手以后发现玩法其实比较像兽人必须死，但是兼备快节奏FPS的爽快感和一些科幻飞船要素，有点roguelite要素，新档需要捡垃圾解锁蓝图，局内就是收集资源按策略升级装备，算是EA阶段内容待补充而采取的拖时间方案，不过还是挺不错的，就看内容能扩充到什么地步，目前联机是还没加进来，当然单人玩也完全没问题，不过巨型炮怪有点粪，就突出一个肉和高伤，不像其他类型的敌人有各自的特性和需要针对的点，而且目前只有一个船型，地形重复度会比较高，能做的只有根据喜好取舍区域来防守 另外优化有点差，作为低面数游戏，某些时候怪堆得多的时候帧数会骤降

底子很不错的一款游戏，但很多方面还有待改进，以下是我的一些建议 1.没有敌人图鉴和装备图鉴，添加图鉴可以帮助玩家了解自己还有什么蓝图没有解锁，以及敌人的特点 2.游戏中解锁新的陷阱蓝图过于依靠运气。老是给一些已经有的陷阱蓝图，可以添加一个保底的机制 3.飞船可以添加更多的种类，比如更小的飞船，有更少的房间可以防守，但是飞的更快（体现为敌人追上需要更多回合） 4.没有测试关卡，玩家第一次进入新地图不够熟悉地图点位，很有可以找不到敌人的出口和可以放置陷阱的位置，甚至发现自己的陷阱对于地图内有些点位是完全没有作用的，可以添加一个纯测试关卡来让刚玩没多久的人熟悉各个地图 5.新手教程过于简单了，完全就是教了一下如何操作然后就直接让玩家面对游戏，可以适当复杂化一点 以下是我游玩过程中的一些小发现 开局看似没有给你选择武器和陷阱的权利，但实际上有初始的研究点和资金，可以挑几个自己喜欢的武器和陷阱直接解锁，前提是你在之前有上传过对应的武器或陷阱蓝图 飞船不是只能前进的，是可以后退的，你完全可以打一个敌人拿两条路的奖励，只要算好回合数 霰弹枪对很多陷阱打不动的怪物有奇效，虽然装弹慢子弹少，建议装了霰弹枪之后还能再带其他武器再使用 然后根据开发路线图，后面是有多人合作模式，无尽模式的，还有更多的武器和陷阱，虽然说算是画大饼就是了，但还是挺期待的

So if you fail a level once you just get a game over and have to start from the very beginning again with no gear and no second chance at all. nice. Edit for the dev reply: I understand that there is a permadeath aspect to it, but what happened to me is not fun at all. I'm talking about 1 level fails, i still have lives, and it literally plows through the next level with no chance to actually stop it, goes straight to my core and destroys my ship with no further chance. It has happend 2 times now and is not fun at all. Furthermore, even with the death things happening, it took me a total of 6 hours for the entire game, and there is no multiplayer on launch (they advertised it as a multiplayer experience) and there is no other game mode or anything else to do once you reach the end. not worth the 20$ price tag for sure.

游戏难度太高，前几波陷阱作用太小，可玩性太少，波次太少，经常你还没有感受到塔防乐趣就结束最后一波了，完全没有任何塔防游戏性质，而且经常多线防御没有唯一必通过路径，经常防御困难，总体评价如果你想玩一个爽快的游戏那么此游戏不推荐！而且注意本游戏没有无限波次的无尽模式！！！！！！！！！！

玩了6个小时才差不多能熟练的比较稳定的通关，这难度感觉是给后续更新多人联机准备的 总体游戏还是不错的，暂时给个差评，希望作者能看到 后续更新后会修改评论！ 1.单人情况能否降低游戏难度 2.除了食堂以外，其他区域基本都是多路线，仅在出口处短暂交集地形，很多时候并没有很好的部署物但却从分别两条大路的支路刷怪，这根本就很难防守。 ！！！！！！ 3.地面能否显示高亮箭头标识出刷怪路线 4.每一小关结束后能否自动拾取全图零件 5.绿色小虫和飞行紫虫数量众多且对玩家也能造成可观伤害，但击杀后却不掉落零件，往往这类敌人数量众多，导致根本无法拥有足够零件部署 部署物 （这两类敌人能否掉落零件） ！！！！！！！ 6.后期秒杀玩家的巨型敌人单纯血厚，后续更新要么像僵尸一样对这类敌人添加明显弱点，或者对这类敌人增加属性弱点，比如弱火 弱电 7.增加研究点获取量，以上传过图纸的武器 部署物 道具 下一轮游戏自动解锁无需额外支付研究点和金币， 过于寒酸的研究点获取量导致玩家试错成本过高，最终会选择最稳妥的加点方式降低了大量武器和部署物的出场几率。很多时候为了更多体验满改武器或部署物，不得已多走回头路拾取更多研究点导致和捕猎队硬碰硬。 ！！！！！！！！ 8.捕猎队和飞弹每次移动需强制拉动镜头聚焦过于拖延时间。 9.击退跳帮敌军后并无任何奖励，导致多轮高难度与敌军交战大大消磨心态。一但反跳帮失败挫败感过大，但连续击败3只跳帮队（含捕猎队）无任何奖励。 ！！！！！！！

总的来说：流程太短了，地图简单，陷阱鸡肋，敌人火力强大，好不容易发展起来了，游戏结束了。 就冲这陷阱设计，我高度认可哨卫（Sentry）存在的意义：没有我本人根本不可能守住任何一路。我已经通关近10次，解锁了大部分陷阱装备，最好用的还是游戏最开始给的那两个。哪怕装了新的陷阱，主要的输出还是我自己，只要我没换主武器，游戏模式就没有一点变化：快速放陷阱，开枪，跑到另一条通道，开枪，开始下一波———— 游戏的地图机制是不是有点太简单了？六条路直通基地，敌人随机从几个入口突破，道路在接近尽头的地方收束，中间不存在任何改变敌人行进方向的方式。包括第一回合在内，提前召唤敌方进攻会提供额外金钱奖励，哪怕放弃额外奖励也没多长时间探图。正是在这种紧迫中，我误以为部分地图中的舱门可以改变敌人行进路线，后来在发现哪怕旁边可以绕过敌人也会停下来攻击大门后，更多的失望。 玩家在整个游戏过程中会被逼入一种极限的紧迫之中，而这种紧迫之后并没有带来应有的回报，甚至由于一轮游戏结束得过快而没有机会感受这些小小的回报。

$20 is steep for the current state of the game. I know I've only got an hour of playtime but trust me when I say it's not worth the price currently. If/When the add coop, sure maybe. But currently the game is balanced as IF you had a 2nd person. But it's a singleplayer game. So you feel overwhelmed rather quickly and the early on/starting equipment feels incredibly weak. tldr: balance wonky, no coop yet, wait for a few updates and $20 is steep so wait for a sale or something. REVIEW UPDATE: 11/27/24 11:53 AM I made this review on: Jun 16 @ 8:16pm And since then I've played the game a bit more since there have been more updates and coop is apparently on the way but still only in beta. Balance is still awful, the game still treats the player as if there are 2 of you, and the equipment you get vs the amount of enemies and their strength is not balanced in any way shape or form. It feels like no matter what I do, no matter what weapon I have, or what traps I utilize. They all shoot cotton balls and effectively make the experience a slog and unfair. This is a game that has a lot of good elements, a great style, and interesting gameplay. But is it a fun game as it is? Absolutely not. Save your money and wait for future updates. That being said, good luck FirebladeSoftware. I firmly believe in your ability to make something great out of this title and I'm looking forward to what becomes of this game going forward.

如果是奔着塔防来的，那一定会失望，因为你能在前中期找到的只有陷阱。我的第一座能用的“塔”是在通过了9次游戏以后，在困难模式(3大关)找到的电塔。当我满怀期待地放下第一座电塔后，彻底失望了：极低的伤害，连小怪都要打两下，超长的攻击间隔(5秒左右)，极高的价格(80)，甚至限制只能放5个，而且在怪的集火下会很快被摧毁。唯一的优点是被电的敌人会被减速几秒。 从这些可以看出来，这其实并不是一个塔防游戏，塔的作用只是辅助你，帮你拖延一些时间。来腾出换弹的时间。 塔的性能极低，获取不稳定，起码在我最有耐心体验游戏的前几个小时，没有见到任何一座塔。 路线图设计极其无聊，没有太多的可探索性，唯一能吸引你的只有装备点（三选一道具武器资源），然后就是不可避免的战斗，重复且枯燥。 最新更新的开局飞船选择，毫无区分度。初始船给每一波额外25碎片。医疗船让你每一波自动回满血，工程船是获得的物资点+25%，科研船是绿点+25%。问题是，升级局内道具同时需要科研点和物资点，你即便有10000物资，没有科研点也不能升级道具。那这两艘船不是来搞笑的吗？医疗船更是没用，本来地图上就有回血点，也能通过部署获得更多的回血点，医疗船的被动只是能省几秒跑路的时间。所以初始船就是性价比最高，最好用的船。另外，不同的船布局也是一模一样的，完全没有区别。 在种种低区分度的道具，武器，陷阱，飞船，叠加之下，就导致了游戏的可玩性极低。 这个游戏最明显的缺点就是可部署物的性能低下，而且防御塔的获取难度极高。不如初始就解锁塔的蓝图，而不是只给玩家两个垃圾陷阱。 现在，这个游戏只能当做一款轻量级的射击小游戏来玩。。

Just not fun. It's a "tower defense", but it's not a very competent one. First of all, this is clearly [i]inspired[/i] by "Orcs Must Die". You're in first person, you have the build and defend phases, there are multiple breaches, traps and weapons. Since rogue-like are all the rage, it's also a rogue-like, because why not. The problems are: [list] [*]You build phase is time limited. Tower defense is a strategy genre, I could forgive this if building was intuitive and convenient, or if less emphasis was put on building. But as is - it just feels annoying and needless. [*]You're offered a huge incentive to finish the build phase in the first 25% of the timer, as you get a large sum of build resources if you do. So the game says to you "if you want a reward, build in less than 10 seconds". You have to run around, you have to learn the layouts - it's just unreasonable. But if you don't go for it - you're losing out on valuable resources, so valuable that it's a matter of a couple of extra traps. [*]Starting traps are rather pointless. You get a slowing floor trap and you get a damaging wall trap. They are pointless because there aren't many choke points for the traps to be effective. Flying enemies just fly over both of these too. [*]Ammo is limited, and very much so. With my ~90% accuracy, I was running out of ammo in less than a minute. Considering that a wave lasts a few minutes, you're pretty much guaranteed to run out midway through. To restock you have to run to an ammo resupply cabinet and hold a button to get multiple extra magazines. While you do that - enemies just run through. [*]Almost every enemy, including the most basic ones are ranged. This means that you get shot at, constantly. It would seem okay, but the levels are cramped, so there's not much space to hide and return fire. You're going to get hit, and it feels like a chore. You have lots of health, but because avoiding damage is such a chore it just feels like a pointless extra resource to manage. [*]Positive feedback loop. This means that if you're doing poorly - the game punishes you by cranking up the difficulty and if you're doing well - the game rewards you by reducing the difficulty. You've got a nice trap setup and shot everyone in the head? You can just let out the next wave immediately and get that sweet cash so you can get even more resources. After that when you beat the level - we're going to give you more upgrade credits too! You've let enemies past? - too bad, part of your ship is permanently damaged and you have to fight again but in a worse situation now. Oh, and no upgrade credits for you. When it goes well - it's boring, when it goes poorly - it's pointless, as you don't feel like you have even a chance to recover. [*]"Fun" weapons. You start with a pistol and you can get an SMG early on. The pistol couldn't be just a pistol, it had a delayed explosion added to it. The explosion actually does next to no damage, it's pretty much pointless, and the right way to use the pistol is to get headshots. Those explosions, you mostly notice them when you walk over an enemy corpse and damage yourself from that delayed explosion. SMG has a massive spread after first few shots, so the right way to use that is as a tactical rifle more or less. It feels really contrived, and not in any way satisfying. [*]"Large" levels. The levels are somewhat large, but more than 50% of the space is outside of the enemy path, it's there "for you", this just adds more running and makes the layouts more convoluted for you without actually adding anything to the gameplay, except longer traversal. [/list] I don't know who this game is for, and I imagine it could have been better in co-op, but as is - it's just a baffling mess.

[h1] 简单回复一下各位的一些疑问和宣传 [/h1] 1.宣传片里的炮塔呢？为什么我通关那么多次也没看见？(注：现在正式版也有） 目前请打开游戏测试版进入beta版本，官方在优化稀有塔防和装备的获取，现在在最新测试中，炮塔类武器只能在绿色的补给信标中出现（必须打有三个区域的困难模式才能大量出现绿色信标）好处是绿色信标给炮塔的概率非常之高 2.关于本作在射击和塔防上的问题 本作在解锁自动炮塔（转轮）后，是一个塔防和射击参半结合的游戏，必须要在升级枪械，道具和炮塔中做出选择。一般本着能不用炮塔就不用的原则去打会好很多（因为炮塔普遍造价高，很难补充。单个炮塔容易炸，多个炮塔容易一起炸，能用你手打消耗多少就消耗多少） 3.关于多人联机问题 官方已出多人联机，目前最多支持2人，计划最多支持4人 4.关于轮椅和稳定通关困难模式 只要你解锁了自动炮塔，一直升级自动炮塔和少量升级武器，基本可以稳定通关。 目前的三种炮塔： 自动炮塔（远射程，高伤害，会过热，最强炮塔) 霰弹炮塔（中射程，除非贴脸不然就是刮，持续火力，高击退力） 特斯拉塔（近射程，中伤害，要充能，最废炮塔） 注：所有炮塔死亡后都会爆炸，切勿放的过于密集，血少直接回收重新放置就是维修 废物陷阱： 传送带（不在深坑区几乎没用） 地雷（价格不低效果普通还是一次性陷阱） 漩涡方格（不在深坑几乎没用） 炸药桶（这玩意放多了一炸乱飞能炸死你，单放一个后期还没用） 脉冲板（又贵效果又差） 强力陷阱： 垂直悬浮器（更新之前只卖30块（现在70），一级就能控大怪很长时间） 放热器（便宜好升级，效果性价比高） 眩晕喷射板（满级质变，范围中毒失衡） 主流强力主武器： MP45（升级便宜，90发弹夹无论远程点射还是扫射清群都是很好的选择，初始武器） AR44（伤害很高的突击步枪，下挂榴弹发射器，非常标准的均衡后期武器） 火球枪（升级便宜，平A伤害较高，弹速慢，散步较大，蓄力是很强的范围燃烧） 磁轨炮（大狙，唯一一把能两发打死黄色机枪怪的超高伤害武器，后期清大件） 爆弹步枪（大狙爆弹版本，升级可以清群可以单体爆输出，打盾牌怪最强的武器） 废物武器： 和平使者（转轮霰弹看似很强，实际上贴脸打不中，远了没伤害，震爆弹也废物） 特射步枪（这玩意伤害和AR44差不多的情况下还没有AR44的全自动和榴弹） 泵动霰弹（和转轮霰弹一个道理，但是手感能比转轮好点） 主力强势道具： 高爆手雷（最实在的主动物品，多种情况下都有用） 防弹护甲（相信我，没有这个你后期打大件活不过一分钟，基本无脑点的被动物品） 治疗针（稍微升级一下很多情况下就能救命，满级可以化身肘击王） 废物道具： 漩涡手套（除了深坑区就几乎没用） 闪光弹（你有功夫升这个还不如升手雷） 喷射背包（我是很难理解这个三段跳意义何在，你地图很少有靠跳跃赶路的图） [h1] 最后宣传一下Sentry交流群：964656646 [/h1] [h1] 我每天基本都会在下午或者晚上直播Sentry，b站名字是Blackraven鸦 [/h1]

Way less dynamic than anticipated. I imagined that maps would vary a bit more, that each round was different and dynamic, but i ended up doing the same over and over again. A very limited map pool without any randomness, not even really the spawn points of enemies. So i was playing the same map a lot, ended up reinforcing the same hallway the 12th or so time with the same traps and then shooting a bit in the general direction of the enemies running on their fixed path, with the same rather boring equipment. A comparison would be Orcs must Die or Dungeon Defenders and with that comparison, both were vastly superior in every way. I like the way they went about picking your route with upgrades. They need to embrace that far more, adding more dynamics on the map, more CoD Zombie Mode-like interactions (close doors permanently or whatever), maybe a bit Rainbow Six Siege Defense Role mechanics (reinforcing stuff, forming new paths, repairing things etc). I imagined this to be far more interactive and with far more things to do. Like me needing to repair electric stuff because enemies turned the light off or a ship part was damaged and now floods an area with poisonous gas, maybe a destroyed window permanently causes an area to be without air or maybe enemies take paths through ventilation systems. And in return i wished i got tools to combat those things. Repair ship systems to enable effects and conditions again to my favor, close areas off or seal exit points like vents, allow me to enable or disable stuff on purpose, to slow enemies, damage them, lead them a way. There are glimpses of that, but by far not enough and not with the necessary gameplay depth i imagined. This also goes with enemies "capturing" ship areas. The devs didnt make use of that idea to give it any gameplay impact. Like me being fundamentally unable to make use of a certain function as long as the area is occupied. Also wished i had to kind of clean the ship from that alien contamination properly. Upgrades and gadgets furthermore didnt feel impactful enough to make a drastic difference and they certainly were far too conservative, not changing something in a fundamental way (like "Your Turrets now move around as combat drones" or "your bullets now bounce around" or maybe even upgrades that affect the galactic map or map conditions). ALl in all, its not a bad game, just overpromising in a way, that it gives the illusion of potential, that ended up to not be utilized by the devs. It still can be utilized. It needs not just more, but more dynamics and interactions. More stuff to experiment and combine, to synergize and try out. Only have like 6 weapons? Fine, but now add modifications i can find that drastically change them and what they do. Let me upgrae my ship so certain things become available on each map or i lose functions when losing a section to aliens. Dont just let me shoot stuff, but also repair, reinforce or manipulate. Make the maps more dynamic, mix up conditions each time, maybe add or remove certain areas on them (like one time a path is open, next time its closed), multiple paths, enemies using different paths. My main gripe, as you could read, is not the traps or the weapons per se, its that its too thin and samey. Yeah sure, i can pick a different type of trap or gun, but that alone doesnt make fun gameplay. In these games the maps and what you can do on them is important, especially when you have to replay them so often. Have it still wishlisted and follow development. I hope they add MORE depth, not just more enemies or guns, but actual mechanics and interactions that make each defense mission interesting.

Sentry almost reaches greatness with its solid gameplay but falls short due to the outside systems surrounding it. The layout of the ship and multiple attack vectors incentives the player to neglect the outer sectors and focus on the two choke points leading to the core, leading to the same levels being played back to back for an [b]entire run[/b]. This leads to a repetitive routine of defending the same two sectors and the core back to back, which is exacerbated by the lack of tools available to a new player, building the same set of traps on the same levels over and over again. The core is there, the moment to moment gameplay is great. The lack of variety overall and enforced by the outside systems hinder it too much for me to recommend it.

Decent concept, but there are some issues I would want to see addressed before I would recommend this game to others. * Performance issues - Frame stutters regularly throughout the game. * Forced Damage - When your ship is hit by two boarders at once, it's impossible to defend both locations, so one is guaranteed to be destroyed. * Repair Costs - The cost to repair is rather high, especially considering guaranteed damage. And since it always falls on the host in co-op, the host feels locked out of high-level upgrades if they are constantly repairing the ship. * Hard Mode Missile Instant-Loss - In hard mode, if the missile catches you, it instantly destroys the ship, even at full strength. Since you can't scout the whole map, this can make an unfun situation where you make a move, then literally don't have enough time to get to the exit, so the run is over (even if you don't realize it yet). All time spent after that will feel like a waste. I'd like to see the missile just damage the ship, except for the aforementioned cost issues. * Gun VS Deployable Imbalance - The guns feel like the primary method of defense, with deployables only a secondary aid (especially before you have many deployables unlocked). This not only limits tactics (disallowing a "Tower Defense" style of strategy), but makes the player feel forced to upgrade weapons over deployables at the start (reinforcing that tactical limitation). There's a lot to like about the game, so I will hopefully come back after some updates, or full release from Early Access.

this game doesn't know what it wants to be: If its an FPS you are far too sluggish and flimsy to really deal with the constant waves of enemies with guns shooting back at you. If its a cover shooter then the cover in the game needs to be drastically increased and improved. if its a trap builder the traps need to be much stronger. If its a tower defence then the turrets need to be able to hold their own in fights. its got a lot of elements of a lot of good genres but nothing that really binds it all together, if you are looking for a game where you can do action and tower defence at the same time check out orcs must die, which knew to make the player tough as nails but pretty weak and make the traps and defences the stars. Sentry seems to want to make you the star with the traps just kind of helping out but the speed at which you die to damage if you aren't constantly evading or hiding is just laughable, and the respawn takes so long you are guaranteed to lose a bunch of lives in your wave before you even can move, let alone get back in the fight. Separately these issues would be fine. (if you die fast and respawned instantly for instance) but Sentry seems to not really understand how tower defences work, the biggest sign of this is there view on spawn locations for enemies, which used to randomly shuffle about wave to wave and now only *slightly* do that.... as opposed to just, being set each round like every tower defence that has ever been made. Its a game that is learning lessons it could have learned just by studying other games in the genre, at some point i have faith the game will be better than it is, on that day I'll change the review, but thats yet to happen.

So, I'm only an hour in but I really don't get this game. I'm having a hard time convincing myself to come back to it. It's quite hard for a tower defense game, but also quite boring for a first-person shooter. I'm playing it solo currently, but I wouldn't ask my friends to buy it. The beginning of the game is quite boring. - You only get two things to place. A small slowdown pad and a wall-turret that shoots directly in-front of it two units. There is no way to funnel or redirect the enemies. - Each stage is only three waves, so you don't get many chances to place traps, or accumulate a large defense. - The maps are quite elaborate and branching, and enemies don't have an intended path displayed. And there are always two entry points so placing traps effectively is difficult. - there are many places you cannot mount a wall-turret. And slowdown pads can't be mounted on slopes. In the early stages I've played, this robs you of placing traps at most choke points. - The corridors of the map are always at least three units wide, which means the wall-turret they give you doesn't cover them even at most choke points. And this turret doesn't do enough damage to kill even the weakest enemy. - The wall-turret also has a significant reload time, which means no enemy gets hit by the same wall twice, even when using slowdown pads. - It is confusing to navigate the stages, because they are much bigger than they need to be. Because stages are reused in future levels, with new entry points. All of the above results in the tower defense side of the game, being very ineffective. Your player character is required to kill the vast majority of the enemies. This results in you playing a First-person shooter, with enemies walking towards you in a corridor. This is very boring. The shooting is hindered by limited ammo, which makes you run back to an ammo station to refill, which is also limited. I don't understand the point of limited ammo, the enemies are not hard to hit, they move predictably and are in a corridor. I always have decent accuracy, and I pretty much always use all of the ammo in a stage. The guns are weak, and the waves of enemies are not satisfying to shoot into. You would normally feel good about collecting many enemies into one small spot and disposing of them, but this actually makes the shooting feel worse because it feels like you're not doing damage. A wall of enemies coming at you is bad, but slowdown pads cause them to bunch up like this. Overall it isn't fun as a tower defense. And isn't fun as a shooter. Dungeon Warfare shows how dungeon trap style towers can be fun. And Sanctum shows us a first-person tower defense can be fun. I'm sorry to the developer, I know this has been in development a while, and I have been excited to try it since 2024. But this is fundamentally not fun, and maybe the game gets more fun later... but I'm not gonna make it that far.

If I could give a neutral review I would. I LOVE this genre - combining active gameplay with the usually passive tower defense. Dungeon Defenders, Sanctum 1 and 2, I loved those. I loved grinding in DD with friends, I liked exploring for easter eggs in Sanctum, I like the give and take of active combat and static defenses. And this game looks *really* promising! Graphics are fine. Maps are much smaller compared to those other games, but they're chunks of a larger ship that you defend, and they're fine. Maybe a bit too tight, but it's whatever. The enemies though... they have too much hp and they deal too much damage. If the shooter enemies see you, you can take one of them by juking their aim - but if there are also melee guys, or more than one shooter, you have to fall back to cover. You die SO FAST, even with armor. The wall traps can kill enemies, but the tougher dogs and the shooters can walk through them and survive. And the wall traps have a slow recharge time, so enemies WILL walk through. You cannot 100% depend on the traps. OK, that's fine, just means you need to be more active - except when you run out of ammo, or take too many hits, you *cannot* retreat for supplies, cause enemies WILL escape. And it's not like you can rambo defend a choke point against enemies that take a full clip and keep coming and can down you quickly. There just doesn't seem to be enough scrap for traps, not enough ammo for the guns, and not enough damage. Maybe you just *have* to be consistent at head shots on every enemy? But if that's the case, then I just can't play. And maybe it's drastically easier with multiple players? But I don't know anyone else interested in this genre. It's still EA, there's room to change and grow, but... ugh. It's just not fun. I feel like I'm trying to hold back a river from getting through, and it's just futile. If I'm struggling on the tutorial levels, it's not like I can just pick an easier difficulty. So, no, I don't recommend the game, as-is - but maybe it's a skill issue.

Lets talk about what it offers not its potential. Its got potential. The game as is, is not close to finished. Its missing a reason to play. The rougelikeness of the game is not complete. You dont really feel the need for more defenses unless we are talking turrets which are hands down worth 3-4 of the other defenses on their own. Once you complete a run with them you get the feeling that you should just sit at base and defend from there, That is correct. Over power the waves with all of your traps in a single killing field, and GG. The Enemy variation is bad right now. The game feels clunky, the maps are basic. Thats my take away having played 3 of the current 4 ships and roughly 20ish maps. The character is basic, it needs entire systems intoduced to effect them. Levels to my understanding are just more Hp for your character. You know the entire game the second you get your first turret. Thats all of the complexity. Ive never once maxed a tower. Or a gun. I havent needed too. You dont carry anything between runs but unlocks, so its not like you really save enough to get op. Everything is just there and you play the same way you have since you started. I would like to see more enemies per map, more scrap, and less reliance on your own guns. Kinda like dungeon defenders. You can defend but its not gonna be the best bet 90% of the time. There is no real endless mode, no really limit testing that ive found. The hard mode is better but still bland. I would wait to but it. Until its out and you have more to do. I think the alpha is frankly a bad look. Its missing too much to feel like I can trust the devs to complete it. Dont get burned. Hold out.

Me and my wife picked this game up because we both love tower defense and roguelite games, and honestly, it looked really promising. Unfortunately, only about 3 hours in, I’m already considering uninstalling it. The difficulty feels absolutely insane. We’re experienced gamers — gaming is one of our main hobbies. We’re not pros, but we’re definitely not beginners either. Despite that, this game feels brutally punishing in ways that just aren’t fun. Enemy flow feels strange because enemies either swarm you or trickle in oddly. The biggest issue, though, is the damage EVERY enemy does. Whether playing solo or co-op (not sure if enemy HP/damage scales with player count), we constantly get destroyed no matter what stage we are in the game. The entry barrier is rough when nearly every enemy hits like a truck. I’ve seen other reviews mentioning that they took breaks from the game, came back later after some time/updates and started getting completely annihilated. Even the tutorial was beating us down. Enemies are both extremely tanky and deal absurd amounts of damage, which makes armor feel almost useless — especially since you have to spend resources to buy it. Reviving dead sentries is also expensive and requires resources that don’t drop often enough. I found a legendary knife and thought, “Finally, maybe this will help.” Nope. The damage was terrible, even after getting items that boosted melee damage. Melee feels heavily punished in this game because enemies can instantly kill you the second you get into range. There’s basically no reward for taking that risk. Traps also feel underwhelming. They only seem effective against smaller enemies, while larger enemies just walk straight through them — especially shielded enemies. I was especially excited to unlock sentry guns because I love using them in just about any game we play, but they feel incredibly weak. They fire one volley in the direction of the first enemy they see, then immediately go on cooldown. Very disappointing. Overall, I’d recommend waiting for a big sale or holding off entirely until the balancing issues are addressed. The core concept is genuinely cool, but right now the combination of enemies being overly tanky while also dealing massive damage makes the experience more frustrating than fun. If you want a more balanced version of this style of game, you’re probably better off playing Orcs Must Die! instead.

i've mixed feelings on this, but since i love the feeling of "FTL but you're playing as one of the security crew", and I have no doubt people get a lot of good out of this game, I would generally recommend it. HOWEVER, I personally have found my experience so far to be grating. This is baffling to me, as all other reviews seem to remark on the difficulty going from easy to breezy depending on whether you use turrets or not, and while I have prayed for every hour spent, I havn't managed to find any of these mythical machines. I have been relegated to putting little traps on the floor and walls, and then done the spray-and-pray until I reach a level (sooner rather than later) where the enemies would either go straight past me or ignore my cool Quake-like movement and simply stomp me into the ships hull. While the "Orcs must Die"-esque deployables (further enhanced by environmental kills) are great and fun, they don't seem particularly effective, and the best choices seem to be anything with crowdcontrol, so that you can shoot them with your lil gun. In that vein, my best run saw me reach midway through the 2nd zone by solely upgrading an smg i found, but it seemed a little boring to turn my tower defense into a just-about-decent FPS. Whatever I am doing wrong compared to my peers, it turns every run a hunt for any and all supply pods that might provide equipment that might buy me another twenty minutes of uninterrupted playtime, but so far no success. Perhaps further updates to the game will help me become someone who can breeze this. Recommended for people who love the concept and can endure some hard times.

Super fun, and highly recommend. Not really a complaint here, just an observation, but the shotgun sentries are in need of a balance pass, or everything else needs a buff. The shotgun sentries are S+++ tier and most everything else is C-B tier. I really like how you permanently unlock equipment, it makes you really have to commit to wanting to unlock things or ensuring your success, so there is this great natural balance that happens with progressing. I also thing the guns are very well balanced overall, and all of them are fun in their own way. When I first started getting into it, I wasn't a fan of how the guns felt, like why does the SMG feel so much worse than the AR, then it made a lot more sense that the weapon slot size really indicates the weapons power, the system isn't perfect, but it feels very fun to mix and match weapons to really take advantage of ammo, or just go all in on 1 or maybe 2 guns and just lean on those all the way to the end. I have very much enjoyed my time with the game, and will continue to play it throughout its updates. I'm a big fan of this one.
